actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept game animation sprite. Make ONE completely rendered new full-body frame, native square at least 1024x1024, actual transparent RGBA alpha. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact camera, face, head and body proportions, all hair, jade green/ivory/gold clothing and long bamboo bow shape/held height, right-shoulder quiver. Image2 is original identity, image3 is PRIMARY STYLE reference, retain their clean rounded bright hand-painted look. No added objects, no text, no ground/shadow. Keep entire figure/equipment inside margins. Bow stays relaxed in anatomical LEFT hand at middle grip, right hand free, no arrow nocked. Change ONLY walking limb articulation/necessary garment folds as described. Frame the body exactly as image1. Redraw requested pose; do not just duplicate its pose. EXACT EAST side view facing screen RIGHT, camera unchanged. Reverse the leg crossing visible in image1. The NEAR leg is the one that starts on SCREEN LEFT under the near hip: its thigh must now angle strongly diagonally DOWN-RIGHT across the foreground, passing IN FRONT of the far thigh, and its boot plants ahead on screen RIGHT. The FAR leg starts on SCREEN RIGHT under far hip and now angles DOWN-LEFT BEHIND the near thigh with the back boot on screen LEFT raised heel toe-touch. Near right leg in FRONT at crossing, far left leg BEHIND. This is the exact opposite stride to image1. Keep gentle normal stride, not a kick. Near right arm swings backward. No equipment changes.
